buckets.name: Air-Source Heat Pumps & Electrified HVAC
buckets.scope: Air-source heat pump and electrified space-conditioning hardware for homes and commercial buildings, including novel cooling cycles (ground-source and district-scale covered separately)
variations: central ducted & mini-split air-source heat pumps — incumbents (Daikin, Mitsubishi Electric, Carrier, Trane, Lennox, Midea, Gree) plus integrated-design challengers (Quilt) and hybrid/dual-fuel configurations
air-to-water hydronic heat pumps for radiator/underfloor systems (Vaillant, Viessmann, NIBE, Bosch, Aira)
cold-climate heat pumps engineered for sub-zero performance (DOE Cold Climate Heat Pump Challenge entrants, Mitsubishi Hyper-Heat class units)
window, room, and portable/packaged heat pumps incl. saddle-style 120V units for apartments (Gradient, Friedrich, NYCHA Clean Heat for All entrants)
commercial rooftop unit (RTU) heat pumps and VRF/VRV systems for light commercial and large buildings (AAON, Daikin VRV, LG Multi V)
high-temperature heat pumps for boiler and steam-system replacement in hydronic retrofits without radiator swaps
natural- and low-GWP-refrigerant heat pumps (R290 propane monoblocs, CO2/R744 systems, R32/R454B transitions)
thermally driven and gas-absorption heat pumps (Stone Mountain Technologies) — transitional niche
solid-state and caloric heating/cooling: thermoelectric (Phononic), elastocaloric, magnetocaloric (Magnotherm), barocaloric (Pascal), thermoacoustic (Blue Heart Energy, Equium)

ultra-efficient AC and dehumidification — liquid/solid desiccant and evaporative-hybrid cycles (Blue Frontier, Transaera, Montana Technologies AirJoule, Mojave Energy Systems) plus high-efficiency HVAC components (Turntide motors, Danfoss Turbocor compressors)

buckets.name: Geothermal, Thermal Networks & District Energy
buckets.scope: Ground-source heat pumps, networked/community geothermal and utility thermal energy networks, and district heating & cooling infrastructure including waste-heat reuse and seasonal storage
variations: single-building ground-source heat pump equipment (WaterFurnace, ClimateMaster, Bosch, NIBE)
residential geothermal developers and drilling cost-reduction plays (Dandelion Energy)
advanced boreholes and commercial-scale geo-exchange (Bedrock Energy, Celsius Energy, Darcy Solutions, Brightcore Energy)
networked geothermal / utility-owned thermal energy networks (Eversource and National Grid pilots, HEET-model projects, NY/MA TEN legislation ecosystem)
district heating development and modernization incl. 4th/5th-generation low-temperature networks (Vattenfall, Fortum) and components/metering (Danfoss, Kamstrup)
district cooling providers and developers (Tabreed, Empower)
large-scale heat pumps and mechanical-vapor-recompression units feeding district systems (MAN Energy Solutions, Siemens Energy, GEA, Star Refrigeration)
waste-heat reuse into buildings and networks — data-center heat (Deep Green, Qarnot, Heata), sewage/wastewater heat recovery (SHARC Energy), industrial heat offtake
seasonal and underground thermal storage: aquifer (ATES), borehole (BTES), pit storage, and sand/rock heat batteries for district heat (Polar Night Energy)
solar thermal district heating and geothermal direct-use heating (Aalborg CSP, Savosolar)

buckets.name: Water Heating & Appliance Electrification
buckets.scope: Electrified water heating and gas-replacing residential/commercial appliances, including hot-water efficiency
variations: unitary 240V heat pump water heaters (Rheem, A.O. Smith, Bradford White, Stiebel Eltron)
120V plug-in and low-amperage HPWHs for no-rewire retrofits
split-system and CO2-refrigerant HPWHs (SANCO2/ECO2 Systems, Reclaim Energy)
smart and grid-interactive water heaters, connected tanks and intelligent controls (Cala Systems, Aquanta, Shifted Energy, Mixergy)
combined space + water heating heat pump systems with integrated thermal storage (Harvest Thermal)
drain-water heat recovery (EcoDrain, RenewABILITY Power-Pipe)
solar thermal and PV-diversion water heating (myenergi eddi class diverters)
hot-water efficiency: low-flow fixtures, demand recirculation controls, leak/flow monitoring (Moen Flo, Phyn, Flume)
induction and battery-integrated cooking (Impulse Labs, Copper, incumbent induction lines; commercial kitchen induction)
heat pump clothes dryers and combo washer-dryers, plus commercial laundry and heat-pump pool heater electrification

buckets.name: Building Envelope: Insulation, Air Sealing & Roofs
buckets.scope: Opaque-envelope demand reduction — all insulation materials including low-carbon/bio-based, air sealing, weatherization tech, and roof systems
variations: cellulose and recycled-content insulation (Greenfiber, CleanFiber, Bonded Logic recycled denim)
wood-fiber insulation (TimberHP/GO Lab, Steico, Gutex)
hemp, straw, mycelium, sheep's wool and other bio-based insulation (Hempitecture, EcoCocon, Biohm, Havelock Wool)
aerogel and vacuum-insulated panels for space-constrained retrofits (Aspen Aerogels, Kingspan OPTIM-R)
low-GWP spray foams (HFO-blown) and foam alternatives for cavity fill
air-sealing technology — aerosolized envelope/duct sealing (Aeroseal) and membrane/tape systems (SIGA, Pro Clima)
weatherization diagnostics and tooling: blower doors, duct testers, IR imaging (Retrotec, The Energy Conservatory)
exterior continuous insulation and overclad systems for walls and roofs
cool roofs, radiative-cooling coatings and films (SkyCool Systems, i2Cool, GAF cool roofing, ultra-white paints)
green roofs and vegetated envelopes (ZinCo, Sempergreen, Omni Ecosystems)

buckets.name: Windows, Glazing & Solar Control
buckets.scope: Fenestration efficiency — high-performance windows and frames, advanced glazing, retrofit attachments, shading, and daylighting
variations: triple-pane and passive-house-grade windows and frames (Alpen High Performance Products, Zola, Internorm, Schuco)
vacuum-insulated glazing (LuxWall, Fineo/AGC, V-Glass, NSG/Pilkington, Panasonic)
electrochromic/dynamic smart glass (View, SageGlass, Halio, Tynt, Miru, Glass Dyenamics)
thermochromic and other passive-dynamic glazing (Suntuitive)
window inserts, secondary glazing and low-e storm windows (Indow, Magnetite, QuantaPanel)
solar-control and low-e retrofit window films (3M, Eastman LLumar)
transparent photovoltaic and energy-harvesting glazing (Ubiquitous Energy, ClearVue) — niche
automated exterior shading, screens and dynamic facades (incl. PV blinds like SolarGaps)
daylighting systems: tubular skylights and diffusing panels (Solatube, Kalwall)

buckets.name: Retrofit Delivery, Electrification Platforms & Financing
buckets.scope: The delivery and capital layer — deep retrofit-as-a-service, whole-home electrification installers/platforms, contractor software, financing, incentives, and workforce
variations: panelized/prefabricated deep energy retrofit (Energiesprong-model providers, RetrofitNY vendors, facade-integrated HVAC like Hydronic Shell, robotic underfloor insulation like Q-Bot)
whole-home electrification platforms and tech-enabled installers (Elephant Energy, QuitCarbon, Zero Homes, Sealed-style models; Europe: Aira, Enpal, 1KOMMA5)
HVAC contractor software and installer enablement: load calculation, design, sales (Conduit Tech, heat-load modeling tools)
heat-as-a-service and subscription comfort business models
efficiency-as-a-service and next-generation ESCOs for commercial portfolios (Redaptive, Budderfly, Metrus Energy, Sparkfund)
retrofit financing: residential/commercial PACE, on-bill and tariffed financing, green home-improvement lending (GoodLeap, Mosaic, PACE Equity, Inclusive Prosperity Capital)
incentive navigation and rebate processing software (Rewiring America calculator ecosystem, IRA/HEEHRA rebate platforms)
digital energy audits, benchmarking and retrofit planning software (Snugg Pro, Audette, Ekotrope, Measurabl-class portfolio carbon analytics)
multifamily/commercial retrofit program delivery and building-performance-standard compliance services (BlocPower, Bright Power, Logical Buildings; NYC LL97/Boston BERDO compliance)
electrification workforce training and contractor staffing tech (Interplay Learning, BlueRecruit)

buckets.name: Smart Controls, Demand Flexibility & Thermal Storage
buckets.scope: Controls and grid-interactive operation — thermostats, HEMS, smart panels, AI building optimization, demand response/VPPs, behind-the-meter thermal storage, ventilation and lighting controls
variations: smart thermostats and home energy management systems (ecobee, Google Nest, Mysa, Tado, Sensibo; whole-home orchestration via Savant, Schneider Home)
smart electrical panels and circuit-level control (SPAN, Lumin, Savant Power, Eaton)
meter collars and panel-upgrade-avoidance hardware enabling electrification on existing service (ConnectDER, NeoCharge, SimpleSwitch)
residential demand response and VPP aggregation platforms (Renew Home, EnergyHub, Virtual Peaker, Leap)
commercial AI building management and HVAC optimization (BrainBox AI, 75F, PassiveLogic, BuildingIQ heritage; steam/multifamily controls like Runwise, Parity)
fault detection & diagnostics, submetering and energy analytics (Clockworks Analytics, Verdigris, Sense, Emporia)
C&I demand response and flexibility market access (Voltus, CPower, Enel X, building-to-grid platforms like Blueprint Power)
behind-the-meter thermal energy storage for load shifting: ice storage (Nostromo, Trane/CALMAC), phase-change heat batteries (Sunamp, Phase Change Energy Solutions)
smart ventilation, HRV/ERV and IAQ-driven HVAC load reduction (Zehnder, enVerid sorbent air cleaning)
lighting and plug-load controls incl. networked LED systems (Lutron, Legrand, occupancy-driven controls)

buckets.name: Low-Carbon Structural Materials & Industrialized Construction
buckets.scope: Low-carbon and carbon-storing structural materials and construction methods for buildings, plus embodied-carbon tooling (cement/steel production itself sits in the Industry sector)
variations: mass timber manufacturing — CLT, glulam, DLT/NLT (Stora Enso, Binderholz, KLH, Mercer Mass Timber, SmartLam, Sterling Structural, Element5)
mass timber design-build, fabricators and developers (Timberlab, intelligent City, tall-timber project developers)
engineered bamboo and fast-growing-fiber structural products (BamCore, Rizome, ReNuTeq)
carbon-storing and bio-based boards, blocks and finishes — agricultural-fiber panels (Plantd), low-carbon plasterboard (Adaptavate), hempcrete blocks (IsoHemp, JustBioFiber)
prefab/modular low-energy construction and SIP systems (Vantem, Plant Prefab, Module, Cuby, Assembly OSM, Juno)
3D-printed and robotic construction with low-carbon material claims (ICON, Mighty Buildings, Alquist 3D)
passive-house components and certified high-performance assemblies (475 High Performance Building Supply, Phius/PHI component ecosystem)
embodied-carbon measurement, EPDs and low-carbon procurement software (Building Transparency EC3, One Click LCA, Tangible, Preoptima, cove.tool)
deconstruction, material reuse and circular-construction marketplaces (Rheaply, salvage/reclaimed structural material platforms)

buckets.name: Refrigerants & Commercial Refrigeration
buckets.scope: Refrigerant transition and lifecycle management plus refrigeration-system efficiency in buildings (Project Drawdown's top-ranked solution area)
variations: low-GWP refrigerant chemistry and production (Chemours Opteon, Honeywell Solstice, Koura)
natural-refrigerant equipment: CO2 transcritical racks, R290 self-contained cases, ammonia systems (Advansor, Hillphoenix, Copeland components)
refrigerant recovery, reclamation and destruction incl. carbon-credit-financed models (Tradewater, Recoolit, A-Gas, Hudson Technologies)
refrigerant leak detection and monitoring hardware (MSA Bacharach, Parasense-class systems)
refrigerant compliance and lifecycle management software (Trakref-class platforms for AIM Act/F-gas rules)
grocery and building refrigeration optimization — AI monitoring/controls, case doors and anti-sweat management (Axiom Cloud, GlacierGrid/Therma)
solid-state and novel-cycle refrigeration for merchandisers and cold cases (Phononic)
